Weather Alerts Issued for Parts of India Amid Monsoon Activity

Several districts in Chhattisgarh and Uttarakhand have received yellow alerts due to monsoon activity. The alerts warn of thunderstorms, lightning, and strong winds in Chhattisgarh, while Uttarakhand faces warnings for heavy rainfall. Residents in affected areas are advised to remain vigilant.
